svg.text: Follow each coloured wire from a part to the ESP32 pin with the same name.
Thick red / orange / black / purple lines are the power rails.
MT3608 boost (turn screw until OUT = 12 V)
use the S (signal) pin of each G·V·S row
IR sensor: bottle waiting at gate
Servo GATE (MG90S) at end of PVC
ECHO direct to D32 (no resistors: VCC is 3.3 V)
brown 12 V · blue GND · black signal
1. Set the MT3608 to 12 V BEFORE connecting the metal sensor.
2. Charger must be 5 V 2 A or more (the servo needs current).
3. ESP32 restarts when the servo moves? Add a 470-1000 uF
capacitor between the 5 V rail and GND.
